calibration: absolute exact empirical mid-rank using all valid nodes except query and immediate neighbors
aggregation: coverage-safe fixed mean; fixed max for diagnostic dual-branch fusion

evaluation_populations.all_nodes: primary; includes normal nodes incidentally touched by interventions
evaluation_populations.clean_normal_comparison: sensitivity; anomaly anchors versus normal nodes whose adjacency was not directly modified

acceptance.per_mechanism: mean AUROC > 0.5 and mean AP > prevalence
acceptance.improvement: structural fixed mean improves both AUROC and AP over contextual exact local in at least 3 of 4 mechanisms per graph
acceptance.ablation: all three leave-one-coordinate-out mean AUROCs remain above 0.5

target_labels: created from intervention anchors; passed only to evaluation after all scores are constructed
development_status: all three citation graphs are development graphs; no definitive real-world claim
